title: Multilevel Training for Kolmogorov Arnold Networks
summary: Algorithmic speedup of training common neural architectures is made difficult by the lack of structure guaranteed by the function compositions inherent to such networks. In contrast to multilayer perceptrons (MLPs), Kolmogorov-Arnold networks (KANs) provide more structure by expanding learned activations in a specified basis. This paper exploits this structure to develop practical algorithms and theoretical insights, yielding training speedup via multilevel training for KANs.
